_note: This file is a pure MMSegmentation configuration file containing only variable assignments and dictionary literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines training hyperparameters, model architecture, optimizer settings, and data pipelines for surface normal estimation using the Sapiens 0.6B Vision Transformer.
review_model_config: review the sapiens_0.6b normal estimation model configuration with embed_dim 1280 and 32 transformer layers
review_backbone_settings: review the mmpretrain VisionTransformer backbone settings with patch_size 16 and sapiens_0.6b architecture
review_decode_head: review the VitNormalHead decode head configuration with cosine similarity and L1 loss functions
review_optimizer_config: review the AdamW optimizer with layer decay rate 0.85 and gradient clipping at max_norm 1.0
review_train_pipeline: review the training data pipeline with random resize, normal crop, and photometric distortion augmentations
